name: Freeport-McMoRan CDR (CAD Hedged
summary: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. is a miner of copper, gold and molybdenum. Its operations are split among US copper mines in Arizona and New Mexico, South American operations such as Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile, Indonesian operations, molybdenum mines, rod and refining, Atlantic Copper smelting and corporate functions.
